cards.title: PORTRAIT SWAP
cards.instructions: Use an AI image tool to make a portrait of your adventure buddy while they make one of you. Get it as accurate as you can, and sneak in as many Easter eggs as possible: favorite foods, hobbies, inside jokes. Then do a big reveal and see how many details you each can spot. For a harder challenge, limit yourselves to a set number of prompts.

cards.title: SAME PROMPT, DIFFERENT OUTPUT
cards.instructions: Pick one short art tutorial (10–20 min) and follow it at the same time as your adventure buddy, side by side or on video. Then hold up your paintings. Same steps, two totally different results. That's the magic.

cards.title: CLEANEST ART EVER
cards.instructions: Open a free online sand-art site (thisissand.com is a great one) and pour colorful layers on screen. Share screenshots as you go, or save it all for a big reveal at the end. No mess, lots of calm.

cards.title: FOLD IT UP
cards.instructions: Pick a beginner origami tutorial and learn it together. No special paper required; regular printer paper works fine. Crumpled first tries are totally allowed. Having fun? Pick another tutorial and keep folding!

cards.title: DON'T GET CAUGHT RED-HANDED
cards.instructions: Have a finger painting party! No brushes allowed. Grab any paint or art supplies you have on hand and make a painting using just your fingers. Keep paper towels close. Optional: paint the same scene, or each do your own thing and compare at the end.

cards.title: POSTAL LOVE
cards.instructions: Make a little art piece for each other: postcard-sized, or go bigger with an 8.5×11 sheet folded in thirds. A 4×6 piece of cardstock works great for a postcard. Write a short note on the back, stamp it, and actually mail it!

cards.title: APP-Y BIRTHDAY
cards.instructions: Ask your adventure buddy for a game they love, a tool that would make life easier, or a problem they're trying to solve. (Or dream up your own idea!) Then each of you vibecodes something for the other. Keep it small and silly or surprisingly useful. Finish with a show-and-tell.

cards.title: THE RIDDLE TRAIL
cards.instructions: Hop in the time machine! A trail of riddles lives right here on this site. Each answer unlocks the next stop, and only the final password opens the last door. Bring your sleuthing skills (and a search engine).

cards.title: CROSSWORD CO-OP
cards.instructions: Find a tough crossword (Saturday puzzles are great) and solve it as a team. One of you shares your screen, and you both call out answers.

cards.title: FRIDGE MAGNET MADNESS
cards.instructions: Start a game on the Fridge Magnets page and send your friends the invite link (no account needed). Everyone gets the same silly prompt and a pile of word tiles. Build the funniest answer you can, read them out loud dramatically, and vote for the winner!

cards.title: STORY PING-PONG
cards.instructions: Take turns writing a story one sentence at a time. No planning allowed. Read the whole thing aloud at the end in your best narrator voice.

cards.title: DOODLE DUEL
cards.instructions: Open skribbl.io and make a private room. Optional: turn on "custom words only" and add your own, inside jokes welcome! Draw, guess, laugh.

cards.title: POSTER CONTEST
cards.instructions: Open Canva and each make the most gloriously UNmotivating poster you can. Optional: send both to a third person to judge without saying whose is whose. Bonus: print one (or both) for your office!

cards.title: PUZZLE MASTER
cards.instructions: Time to level up your cubing! Grab your 2x2 cube and learn to solve it, with a video tutorial or a friend who knows the moves. Go one step at a time and celebrate your first full solve. Bonus challenge: once the 2x2 clicks, the 4x4 is waiting for you.

cards.title: WOULD YOU RATHER
cards.instructions: Start a game on the Would You Rather page and send your adventure buddy the invite link. You'll each get two choices and have to pick one. No skipping! Then see who picked what, and be ready to defend your answers.

cards.title: THE GREAT ESCAPE(OLOGIST)
cards.instructions: Find a free online escape room and try to break out together, side by side or over screen-share. Read every clue, check every corner, and say every wild theory out loud. Can you escape before time runs out?

cards.title: MUG NIGHT
cards.instructions: Two mugs, one cozy night. Mug #1 is a microwave muffin or cupcake (find a recipe online). Mug #2 is a fancy drink: cocoa with whipped cream, iced coffee, exotic tea, etc. Don't forget to clink mugs!

cards.title: CHOPPED
cards.instructions: Give each other a tour of your kitchen and pantry, in person or on video. Each of you picks 4 ingredients the other must use in their Shabbos menu this week. After Shabbos, share the results (and any happy accidents).

cards.title: FOOD FUSION
cards.instructions: Open Google Arts & Culture's food experiment, which blends two cuisines into one new recipe. Pick a recipe for each other, or both make the same one. Swap in kosher ingredients wherever needed.

cards.title: MOCKTAIL MIXOLOGY
cards.instructions: Look up a mocktail recipe, or ask AI to invent one using what's already in your kitchen. Each of you mixes a fancy drink, gives it a name, and garnishes it like a pro. Then cheers and do a taste test! Bonus: turn it into a proper cocktail with some alcohol you have on hand.

cards.title: ALPHABET MOVIES
cards.instructions: Ask Alexa (or any random letter picker) to choose a letter from A to Z. Pick a movie that starts with that letter, press play, and watch together. Popcorn strongly encouraged.

cards.title: MANI HAPPY RETURNS
cards.instructions: Gather your polish, files, and a cozy towel. Do your nails together, in person or on video, while you chat. The drying time is perfect talking time.

cards.title: SHOW AND TELL
cards.instructions: Each of you brings something from your childhood for this show-and-tell. It can be a toy you still have, a photo, or something that represents a memory. Then ask each other more about it.

cards.title: PLAYLIST PARTY
cards.instructions: Make a playlist for each other with songs you think they'll like, or that remind you of them. Want a challenge? Make a playlist where the song titles, in order, spell out a secret (or funny) message.

cards.title: PARTY TRICK ACADEMY
cards.instructions: Learn one simple trick together: a coin trick, a card trick, a tongue twister. Practice side by side, in person or on video. Then each of you gives a grand performance. Applause required.

cards.title: FORCING PARTY
cards.instructions: Each of you picks one task you've been putting off: that email, that drawer, that form. Get together, in person or on video, say it out loud, set a timer for 25 minutes, and work side by side. Cheer each other on at the end, no matter how far you got.

cards.title: TREAT-YOURSELF SPREE
cards.instructions: Agree on the same small budget. Each of you shops online at the same time for treats just for you. Then do a dramatic reveal, one item at a time.

cards.title: CYBER PLANTS
cards.instructions: Each of you builds a little terrarium on Glass Jar Garden and names your plants. Check on each other's gardens over the next few weeks to see how they're growing.

cards.title: HOBBY HUNT
cards.instructions: Visit a craft store with a small budget. Wander every aisle slowly. Bring home one or two treasures that make you excited to create.

cards.title: BRAIN CANDY
cards.instructions: Head to neal.fun, a website packed with weird, wonderful little games and experiments. Click whatever looks interesting and see where it takes you. Do it together and compare favorites, or wander on your own. No goals, no guilt, just fun.

cards.title: BOOK NOOK
cards.instructions: Find your coziest spot with a blanket and a warm drink. Put your phone in another room and read for one whole hour, uninterrupted. Just you and the story.

cards.title: SOUS VIDE YOURSELF
cards.instructions: Run a warm bath with a few drops of essential oil or some bubble bath. Dim the lights, play something calm, and soak. You deserve some self-care tonight.

cards.title: BEAUTIFUL THINGS
cards.instructions: Leave your phone at home and take a leisurely stroll. Find 3 small beautiful things: a leaf, a pebble, anything that catches your eye. Bring them home and snap a photo. Digital variation: put your phone on Do Not Disturb and take 3 beautiful photos instead of collecting things.

cards.title: JUDGE A BOOK BY ITS COVER
cards.instructions: Go to the library and pick a book only by its cover. No reading the back! Not your thing once you start? Return it, no guilt. Tell your adventure buddy which cover won.

cards.title: THANK YOU, GOOD NIGHT
cards.instructions: Think of someone who made your life a little better, recently or long ago. Write them a real thank-you note. On a roll? Write a few more! Send them or keep them, whatever feels right.

cards.title: THE JOY LIST
cards.instructions: Write down 20 things that bring you joy. They can be tiny, like warm socks, the first sip of coffee, a certain song. Small is the whole point. Save it on this card for a rainy day.

cards.title: DEAR ME
cards.instructions: Write yourself a letter to open in one year (maybe on your next birthday?). What's happening now? What do you hope for? Seal it up, write "Open on ___," and hide it somewhere safe where you'll remember it. Digital variation: write it as an email and schedule it to send to yourself a year from now.

cards.title: ONE PHOTO, THREE COLORS
cards.instructions: Choose one photo you both love. Each of you picks only 3 paint colors. Paint the same scene and see how your color choices change everything.

cards.title: BLIND DRAWING
cards.instructions: One of you describes a picture, but you can't say what it is! The other draws only from the description. Reveal and compare, then swap roles.

cards.title: WORD CHAIN
cards.instructions: Pick a category: foods, places, animals, anything. Each answer starts with the last letter of the one before (Apple → Eggplant → Tomato…). Stuck for 10 seconds? Point to the other side.

cards.title: SCREEN-SHARE SHOPPING
cards.instructions: Share screens and browse together, like a mall trip from the couch. Hunt for something specific or build dream carts. Buying is optional; opinions are required.

cards.title: MUSEUM HOPPING
cards.instructions: Pick a museum on Google Arts & Culture and tour it together over screen-share. Each of you chooses a "favorite piece of the day" and says why. Comfy shoes not needed.

cards.title: PAINT TODAY IN THREE COLORS
cards.instructions: Pick 3 colors that feel like today. Paint anything: your view, your mood, or just shapes. There's no wrong way to paint a day.

cards.title: SUNSET & TEA
cards.instructions: Look up today's sunset time. Brew a cup of tea, find a window or step outside, and watch the sky change.
